name: FFmpeg (BtbN GPL builds)
license_note: Built with the BtbN 'gpl' variant: --enable-gpl --enable-version3 (confirmed by the shipped binaries' configuration string and by variants/defaults-gpl.sh LICENSE_FILE=COPYING.GPLv3), so the whole program is GPL-3.0-or-later.

win-x64.note: Replaces the previous Gyan.dev ffmpeg-9.0.2-full_build-shared.zip entry in engines.json with the BtbN GPL build from the same release tag.

binaries_note: sha256/size computed locally by downloading each archive (win64 zip 194034585 bytes hashed a0e45723..., matching the GitHub release asset digest sha256:a0e45723c72141975f51d8666302e614711745f3102b704ca3f82c897a58d278).

buildconf_check.method: 'configuration:' string of each shipped binary (ffmpeg -buildconf run under 'docker run --platform linux/arm64|amd64 ubuntu:22.04' for the two linux builds, 'strings ffmpeg.exe' for win-x64) compared against the source entries.
buildconf_check.result: every --enable-lib*/--enable-* flag that corresponds to a bundled library has a matching source entry; no mismatches.

build_recipe: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds at commit 6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b (the release tag autobuild-2026-09-30-13-08 points at this commit; the 'Build FFmpeg' workflow run 36713993443 that produced this release had head_sha 6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b). Recipe: build.sh + generate.sh + variants/{linux64,linuxarm64,win64}-gpl.sh + variants/defaults-gpl.sh + variants/{linux,windows}-install-static.sh + scripts.d/**/*.sh + addins/9.0.sh (GIT_BRANCH=release/9.0) + patches/ + images/ (base containers).
